name: himalayan-realms
description: Isometric Strategy Prototype set in Himalayan kingdoms

scripts.android:sync: node scripts/bump-apk-version.mjs --sync && npm run build && npx cap sync android
scripts.android:bundle: node scripts/bump-apk-version.mjs && npm run build && npx cap sync android && cd android && chmod +x gradlew && ./gradlew bundleDebug bundleRelease && cd .. && node scripts/package-apk.mjs
scripts.android:apk: node scripts/bump-apk-version.mjs && npm run build && npx cap sync android && cd android && chmod +x gradlew && ./gradlew assembleDebug bundleDebug bundleRelease && cd .. && node scripts/package-apk.mjs
